mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 72 degrees with overcast skies at Verona City Hall, and please be aware of an air quality index of 51.

City officials are busy this September. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September as Hunger Action Month to fight food insecurity and Suicide Prevention Month to provide resources for those in need. Additionally, flaggers will be on Highway M this Monday and Tuesday for utility work, and staff are being honored for their work in building and code safety.

There is plenty to do this weekend. Today, the Dane County Farmers Market is open at the Capitol, and you can catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon takes place, along with a Girls Try Hockey session at the Verona Ice Arena.
In a report regarding calls for service, on August 17, the police department located and arrested a 21-year-old man in the 500 block of Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
Today's flavor of the day is a delicious Mint Explosion. The store is currently open and serving customers until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
